title: Bischof (Bishop)
description: Prepared with oranges and sugar.

ingredients.name: Toasted dark bread crust, cinnamon and cloves (optional)
ingredients.sourceText: Toasted dark bread crust, cinnamon and cloves (optional)

steps: With a knife, lightly score all sides of 8 beautiful bitter oranges with small cuts into the peel.
Roast them on a grate over very gentle charcoal fire.
Make deep cross-shaped cuts in them.
Place in an earthenware pot and pour 4 bottles of good Pontac over them.
Cover the pot well and set on hot ashes for 4 to 6 hours so the oranges infuse well.
You can press them several times with a spoon, or better yet, let them stand overnight.
Press through a napkin and sweeten with {{source-2}}.
The Bishop can be drunk either warm or cold.
You can add a roasted dark bread crust along with some cinnamon and cloves to infuse with it, but the pure orange aroma or taste is always preferable.

title: Bischoffs-Brot, anderer Art (Bishop's Bread, Another Way)
description: A bread preparation made with brown sugar, egg yolks, and egg whites.

ingredients.name: butter for greasing the baking form
ingredients.sourceText: butter for greasing the baking form

steps: Beat 24 drams butter until light and fluffy
Gradually add 28 drams brown sugar and 12 egg yolks and beat well
Lightly fold in the stiffly beaten snow of 10 egg whites with 30 drams flour
Pour into a baking form greased with butter and dusted with flour
Soften 2 to 3 tablets of chocolate on a baking sheet so that a finger can be pressed in
Cut the chocolate into pieces the size of a small finger
When completely softened, insert these pieces into the raw batter in the form as desired
Bake slowly at moderate heat for approximately 1 hour

title: Biscotten (Ladyfinger Biscuits)
description: A biscuit made with egg yolks, egg whites, and wheat flour.

ingredients.name: unblanched almonds for greasing the baking sheet
ingredients.sourceText: unblanched almonds for greasing the baking sheet

steps: Beat 8 egg yolks with 16 drams vanilla sugar until pale
Fold in the stiffly beaten snow of 8 egg whites mixed with 14 drams fine wheat flour
Using a pastry bag or syringe, pipe the mixture onto a baking sheet greased with unblanched almonds in biscuit-like shapes
Dust finely with powdered sugar and bake at low heat in the oven until pale yellow
Remove from the baking sheet with a thin knife and place on a sieve
Alternatively, form heaps of any desired size from this mixture, dust with fine powdered sugar, and bake at low heat until pale yellow
When cooled completely, pair 2 and 2 together, brushing between them with warm candied peel
The stiffly beaten snow of 1 egg white mixed with {{source-7}} and {{source-8}} can be used to fill the biscuits instead of candied peel

title: Biscuit-Torte (Biscuit Cake)
description: A cake made with egg yolks, egg whites, and sugar.
steps: Stir the sugar with the egg yolks for 1/2 hour
Lightly fold in the snow from 12 egg whites simultaneously with 24 Deca fine flour
Fill a cake form brushed with butter and dusted with flour with this mixture
Bake at low heat for 3/4 to 1 hour
Turn the cake out onto a sieve and let it cool
Place it on a sheet of writing paper and cover with glaze of your choice
Optionally, after baking, cut the cake into layers, spread with jam, layer them together, and cover with glaze

Optionally, the stiffly whipped snow from 3 egg whites can be mixed with 12 Deca finely sifted sugar, 2 squares of grated chocolate, or 2 tablespoons of strained strawberries or raspberries, and this can be used instead of jam to spread between the layers

title: Biskuitguglhupf (Biscuit Bundt Cake)
description: A cake made with egg yolks, egg whites, and raisins.
steps: Soften the butter without melting it and beat it
Stir in the flour spoonful by spoonful and beat the mass well and fluffy
If the mixture is too thick, place it on the stove and warm it with constant stirring until it becomes pliable
In another bowl, beat the sugar with 4 egg yolks until frothy and mix this mass well with the first
Finally, very lightly fold in 4 stiffly beaten egg whites and 5 dkg raisins
Fill the mass into a well-buttered or greased form sprinkled with bread crumbs and lined with blanched almond halves
Bake at a fairly sharp fire until light brown
Let the cake cool somewhat in the form after baking, turn it out and dust it with sugar immediately

steps: Gradually beat 5 egg yolks into 16 deca beaten butter
Add 30 deca Perugia sugar and beat for 1/2 hour
Mix in 10 deca finely ground and sifted almonds with skin, 26 deca finely grated chocolate, 1 knife tip cinnamon, equal amount finely chopped lemon peel, and 1 ground clove
Lightly mix in the snow of 5 egg whites with 10 deca flour
Fill into a buttered and floured form and bake approximately 1 hour in a moderately hot oven
Remove from oven and let stand in the form for 1/4 hour, then turn out and dust with finely ground sugar when completely cool

Alternatively, bake this mass in 4 layers. In this case, lightly mix the stiffly beaten snow of 3 egg whites with 10 deca finely ground sugar and 2 tablets of grated chocolate, spread this on 3 baked layers, stack them so that a spread side meets a dry side, place the fourth dry layer on top and cover the whole with chocolate or desired glaze. Baking in several layers is advisable as it easily becomes greasy in the middle otherwise

title: Blaugesottene Forelle (Trout Cooked au Bleu)
description: Prepared with trout, vinegar, and sauce or egg yolk or vinegar or oil or mayonnaise.

ingredients.name: Hollandaise sauce or egg yolk sauce (alternatively vinegar and oil, or mayonnaise)
ingredients.sourceText: Hollandaise sauce or egg yolk sauce (alternatively vinegar and oil, or mayonnaise)

steps: Have 1/4 litre of strong vinegar and some boiling water ready before beginning
Take one trout after another from its container, strike it on the head with the back of a knife and quickly place it back in the container
Prepare a board with cold water, take the trout one by one and cut the belly as quickly as possible from the snout toward the head, place immediately in cold water
With the right thumb, press hard on the gills from snout toward head, in this manner removing blood and entrails, and when you reach the head remove the entrails and heart with the thumb and finger
This removal of entrails must be done while holding the fish in water, where it remains until all trout are cleaned, which must be done as quickly as possible
Be careful not to disturb or wipe off the outer skin of the trout
Place the trout in a fish pan or shallow pan, laying them belly down so closely together that the head of one lies beside the tail of another

If they do not completely fill the space of the pan when lying so closely side by side, fill the remaining space with wrapping paper or a suitable piece of wood so they cannot move and let them stand 1 1/4 hours so the trout become completely stiff

Pour boiling vinegar over them so each one is thoroughly covered, then carefully pour hot salt water (for 1 kilo of trout use 2 strong tablespoons of salt) from the side along the edge so the liquid stands a strong finger's breadth above the fish, but the fish are not directly hit by the water as it is poured

Cover the trout with a sheet of blotting paper brushed with butter, place a small wooden spoon on this to hold the paper down slightly, and let them stand covered at that place on the stove where their broth can be kept near the boiling point but never comes to a boil (the broth should only pass through)
Let the trout stand for approximately 3/4 hours; as a sign of doneness the eyes will protrude like pearls

If serving them warm, remove them carefully from their broth just before serving, arrange them as they lay in the pan but not so crowded together, place some parsley between every 2 trout and garnish the platter with this as well
Serve with Hollandaise sauce, or blend 4 egg yolks with 4 tablespoons of cream, the juice of 1 lemon, 1/3 litre of fish broth and some salt and serve in a sauce boat, also serve vinegar and oil

If serving the trout cold, let them cool in their broth at a cool place, then carefully lift them onto the platter shortly before serving, place aspic or just green parsley between the trout and garnish the platter with this
Serve vinegar and oil or mayonnaise with them

title: Blaugesottener Hecht (Blue Pike)
description: Prepared with white wine, onion, and bay leaf.
steps: Prepare a broth from {{source-0}}, {{source-1}}, a Spanish onion studded with a clove, 1 bay leaf, 5 sprigs thyme, some rocambole, {{source-6}} and pepper, simmering for 1/4 hour
Pour this broth around the edge of the pike as with blue-boiled carp and let stand approximately 1 hour
When sufficiently soaked through, carefully transfer the pike to the prepared serving dish
Strain 1 1/4 liters of the broth through cloth into a saucepan and pour the remainder over the pike
If the pike is not completely covered, dip a piece of linen or white writing paper in the broth and cover the pike with it, leaving a piece of wood in the pike's opening until serving
Add 2 ounces of isinglass or 1 1/2 dissolved gelatin to the 1 3/4 liters of broth and cook for 1 hour
If the liquid is not clear enough, clarify it with 2 egg whites in the same manner as with aspic
When set, pour the broth from the platter on which the pike rests and garnish it beautifully with the prepared, pearled, diced and boiled pike, a part of which can also be colored
Place a sprig of green parsley in the pike's opening after removing the wood
Any type of fish can be prepared in this manner

title: Blitzkuchen (Lightning Cake)
description: A cake made with egg yolks, sugar, and egg.
steps: Beat 14 dkg sugar, 2 egg yolks, and 1 whole egg for 15 minutes.
Very quickly mix in 14 dkg flour and 14 dkg melted, almost boiling butter.
This must be done quickly as the butter will otherwise stiffen and the mass will be hard to spread.
Quickly spread fingerthick onto buttered, floured sheet and bake at higher heat until light brown.
Cut into pieces or strips while still warm, but remove from sheet only when cooled.
The slices can be brushed with marmalade, put together, and dusted with powdered sugar.

title: Blutreinigender Hafertrank (Blood-Purifying Oat Drink)
description: Prepared with oats, saltpeter, and sugar or honey.

ingredients.name: 1 good handful chicory roots cut small
ingredients.sourceText: 1 good handful chicory roots cut small

steps: Take 1.5 pounds of good oats and clean them well
Wash several times with spring water in a sieve
Take 1 good handful of chicory roots cut small
Place the roots and oats in a clean pot
Pour 12 measures of water over
Cook until reduced to half
Strain the remaining 6 measures through a clean cloth
Add 1 loth purified saltpeter and 12 loth sugar
Allow to boil together over heat
Let cool in the same covered vessel for 24 hours in the cellar until completely cold
Clarify from the thick matter that has settled on the bottom into clean earthen vessels
Store for drinking

title: Blutwurst (Blood Sausage)
description: Prepared with blood, onions, and pork fat.
steps: Peel the onions and cut into small cubes
Soften gently in butter
Add two pounds pork fat cut the same way to the onions
Add salt, pepper, spices, finely chopped parsley and young onion
Stir together one measure sweet cream with two measures blood in a pot
Pour this into the casserole with the other ingredients and stir thoroughly so the pork fat distributes well and does not become lumpy
The mass should be neither too thick nor too thin and must have a particularly good taste
Fill into cleaned and well-washed pork intestines using a sausage press
Tie both ends of each intestine securely
Throw into a kettle of very hot water that must not boil
Once the sausages start to become somewhat stiff, prick with a needle
As soon as no more blood runs out, remove from water, let cool, and grill afterwards

title: Blätterteig Dorten (Puff Pastry Cake)
description: A cake made with apricot jam, gooseberry, and almonds.
steps: Prepare butter dough from 56 Deka flour and roll out knife-back thickness
Cut 6 round discs using a cake pan or bowl
Lay them on a water-dampened baking sheet at 2-finger width apart
Make several cuts with a knife and brush with egg wash, keeping the edges knife-back width dry
Roll out the dough scraps thinly and cut out small shapes with forms
Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with pearl sugar mixed with chopped almonds, finely chopped citron and pistachios
Bake all 6 plates at fairly strong heat in the oven
When done, remove from oven and cool
Spread one plate with dissolved apricot jam, cover with a second disc and coat with gooseberry jam, and continue until all 5 plates are used
On top, place the plate decorated with dough, sprinkle the whole thing with finely ground sugar and serve in a bowl
Instead of jam, apple puree, egg cream, vanilla, chocolate, hazelnut, wine or any desired cream may be used

description: Prepared with chuck or oxtail, bacon, and cucumber.
steps: Wash the meat, salt and pepper it
Cut yellow turnip, parsley root, cucumber, and bacon into finger-thick pieces
Make holes in the meat and insert the cut vegetables and bacon
In a casserole, roast the finely cut root vegetables, onion, bay leaf, thyme, peppercorns and spice berries in 6 dkg hot fat until dark
Add the meat, pour broth or water over it
Braise covered for 2 to 2½ hours, basting frequently and turning occasionally
Remove the meat and cut into thin pieces
Strain the sauce, season with vinegar
Bring the meat and sauce to a boil once more and serve on a long platter

title: Boeuf à la Mode (Braised Beef)
description: Prepared with beef, bacon, and marrow.
steps: Pound and salt the beef chuck weighing about 4 kilos
Sprinkle with pepper
Using a small knife, make diagonal slits in the meat and insert finger-length pieces of bacon, marrow, and cooked tongue while drawing the knife out
Let it rest covered in a cool place until the next day
Add to the casserole: sliced onion, root vegetables, {{source-7}}, {{source-8}}, and enough water or broth so the liquid rises above the meat
Braise covered for 4-5 hours until tender
Add a piece of black bread and continue braising covered until done
Place the meat on a serving dish
Defatten the sauce and strain it over the roast
For a rosy appearance resembling corned beef, rub with saltpeter mixed with 1 teaspoon of sugar 48 hours in advance
Let rest covered and weighted
After this time, rinse it off, place in a casserole lined with bacon fat or marrow
Pour wine and rich broth over it so the liquid rises above the meat
Braise covered with bunches of savory but without root vegetables

title: Boiled Milk Soufflé (Soufflé de Bouille)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, egg whites, and jam.
steps: Slowly pour 0.5 liter of cold milk into 16 tablespoons of flour and stir over the fire until it forms a thick dough that separates from the spoon
Transfer to a deep bowl and stir in 12 tablespoons of butter and let cool
Beat 16 tablespoons of vanilla sugar with 8 egg yolks one after another
Mix this well with the cooled mixture
Lightly fold in the snow of 8 egg whites
Fill a buttered form dusted with flour with this mixture
Cover and cook 3/4 hours in a water bath or bake in the oven
Turn out onto a serving dish and serve with jam at table

title: Boiled Trout with Caraway (Gekochte Forellen mit Kümmel-Geschmack)
description: Prepared with trout, vinegar, and onion.
steps: Kill and clean the trout as described for blue boiled trout
Wrap the cleaned trout in a clean cloth dipped in the water in which they lie, wringing it out so no air can enter
In a fish kettle, add 1½ liters water, ½ liter vinegar, 1 tablespoon salt, ¾ teaspoon caraway, and a small piece of onion spiked with 1 clove
Boil this mixture for approximately ¼ hour
Pour the broth through a sieve over the boiling hot trout, which should be in a fish kettle or flat pan
Proceed as with the blue boiled trout
The trout will have a very pleasant flavor, though not as beautiful a blue color as the blue boiled trout
The broth should cover the trout only just barely
Can be served with a white wine sauce or with champagne instead of vinegar, or simply in salt water and caraway or white wine

Form walnut-sized balls with a spoon, fry them brown in hot lard with continuous shaking, and place them on blotting paper.

ingredients.sourceText: brains from 2 veal heads and 2 pork heads

ingredients.name: semmel (roll), soaked in milk and squeezed out
ingredients.sourceText: semmel (roll), soaked in milk and squeezed out

steps: Clean and soak the brains well, cook them, chop finely, and set aside
Chop about one-half pound of onions very finely and soften in scraped bacon
Cook 2 pounds of pork belly meat until soft, cut very finely, and place in a grindstone
Add the bacon and onions along with 6 eggs and stir together
Add some salt, nutmeg, and a milk-soaked and squeezed out semmel
Work everything well together
Finally stir in the brains
Cook the sausage herbs in milk and pour this into the mixture, which should not be too thin
When well stirred, fill into fatty pork intestines and tie securely
Cook the sausages in bouillon
Braise in brushed paper casings on a grill

title: Bratwürste von Karpfen und geräuchertem Lachs (Bratwurst with Carp and Smoked Salmon)
description: Prepared with carp, salmon, and white wine.

ingredients.name: smoked salmon, half the amount of carp
ingredients.sourceText: smoked salmon, half the amount of carp

steps: Properly clean a 3 to 4 pound carp and cut out the fine good flesh
Cut half the amount of flesh from a smoked salmon
Finely dice one semmel and mix together with a sidel of white wine
Soften one handful of onions and some rocambole in butter and add to the above
Add finely pounded sausage herbs
Finely chop one-half pound of cleaned sardelles and 3 drams of capers together
Mix with the juice of one lemon under the rest
Fill the mixture into pork intestines, but not too firmly, otherwise they will burst
Divide into desired pieces and tie with twine
Place in paper casings brushed with butter
Roast slowly on a grill

title: Braune Consomme (Brown Consomme)
description: A soup made with fat or beef marrow or lard or beef fat or veal, onion, and beef.

ingredients.name: fat (beef marrow, lard, beef fat or veal fat)
ingredients.sourceText: fat (beef marrow, lard, beef fat or veal fat)

ingredients.name: 1 large Spanish onion cut into finger-thick slices

ingredients.name: 1 old, roasted hen and 1 old rooster or old dove
ingredients.sourceText: 1 old, roasted hen and 1 old rooster or old dove

ingredients.name: light beef broth (if available) or 4 liters cold water (if not)
ingredients.sourceText: light beef broth (if available) or 4 liters cold water (if not)

steps: Line a casserolle with fat, which can be marrow, lard, beef fat or veal fat, and 1 large Spanish onion cut into finger-thick slices
Add 1 kilo lean beef, 1/2 kilo veal meat, and 12 deca lean ham, leafy-cut
Cover the casserolle with a lid, place on fire and let it brown very well (roast), but it must not burn
Pour 1 ladle full of cold water over it, let it evaporate well and add a second ladle full
Add 1 old, roasted hen and 1 old rooster or old dove
Pour light beef broth (if available) approximately 4 liters over it, or if not available, pour the same amount of cold water
When the rising foam has been removed, add 1 small piece yellow turnip, parsley and celery
Further treatment is as in recipe 3

title: Braune Coulis (Brown Coulis)
description: Prepared with stock, ham, and flour.

ingredients.name: lean ham cut into cubes
ingredients.sourceText: 1/2 pound lean ham cut into cubes

steps: Let 1 measure of stock reduce over moderately strong heat with 1/2 pound of lean ham cut into cubes until it becomes like a thick syrup or resembles dissolved glue
Stir in 2 to 3 spoonfuls of flour
Add again as much good stock so that a quarter of it must reduce to become properly thick or creamy
Stir this broth on the fire until it boils
Let it simmer on slow heat from the side
Remove all foam and fat coming to the surface with a spoon
Let it simmer until it becomes properly thick or creamy
Strain through cheesecloth but do not press through, because it would otherwise not remain clear, especially if vegetables were cooked in it

title: Braune Coulis auf eine andere Art (Brown Coulis, Another Way)
description: Prepared with ham, onions, and stock.

ingredients.name: butter (or proportionally more as needed)
ingredients.sourceText: 1/2 pound butter (or proportionally more as needed)

ingredients.name: lean ham cut into cubes
ingredients.sourceText: 1/2 pound lean ham cut into cubes

steps: Melt 1/2 pound of butter (or proportionally more depending on desired quantity), adding enough flour so it becomes neither stiff nor too thick, but can be stirred comfortably
Stir this continuously on moderately strong heat until it takes on a light brown color
Add 1/2 pound of lean ham cut into cubes, some onion slices, and parsley roots
Braise or brown these in it for a few more minutes
Then pour in as much good brown stock as desired for the coulis
Let it cook very slowly from the side
During cooking, remove all rising fat and foam with a spoon
Once the coulis has cooked long enough to become properly thick, pass it through cheesecloth and use it

title: Braungebuttelte Kohlrüben (Brown-braised Kohlrabi)
description: Prepared with beef fat, onion, and butter or sauce or sugar.

ingredients.name: Soup, enough to cover the kohlrabi
ingredients.sourceText: Soup, enough to cover the kohlrabi

ingredients.name: Butter sauce or white soup with some sugar
ingredients.sourceText: Butter sauce or white soup with some sugar

steps: Peel the kohlrabi, cut them into cubes, and boil them half-tender in salt water
In 8 ounces of beef fat, brown 1 tablespoon of flour, then brown some finely cut onion in it

Cut the leaves finely and mix them with the kohlrabi
Garnish with meat of your choice

description: Prepared with egg yolks, citron, and almonds.

ingredients.name: 5 dkg swelled almonds (cut into thin sticks)

ingredients.name: 3 bread rolls (rinded, cut into cubes, and moistened with milk)

steps: Beat 10 dkg butter until light, then gradually add 4 egg yolks mixed with 8 dkg sugar.
Mix in 3 dkg finely cut citron, 5 dkg swelled almonds cut into sticks, 3 dkg raisins, and 2 dkg currants.
Fold in 4 egg whites together with 3 bread rolls that have been rinded, cut into cubes, and moistened with milk.
Fill the mixture into a pudding mold and let it set in steam for ½ hours.
Loosen, turn out, and serve warm with chaudeau or vanilla cream.

title: Bread Pudding with Mulled Wine
description: A pudding made with egg yolks, breadcrumbs, and chocolate.
steps: Beat 5 dkg butter until creamy
Stir in 4 egg yolks, 5 dkg sugar, 1 dkg breadcrumbs, 1 crushed clove, 1 nutmeg seed, finely chopped lemon zest, and 5 dkg grated chocolate
Fold in 4 egg whites and 8 dkg raw grated almonds
Pour into a pudding mold and cook in a water bath for 1 hour
Turn out onto a platter, pour mulled wine over it, and serve warm
For the mulled wine: boil red wine with 3 cloves, 1 piece of cinnamon bark, and sugar to taste, then strain

title: Bread Roll Soufflé (Soufflé aux Pains Molles)
description: Prepared with bread, egg yolks, and egg whites.

ingredients.name: peeled bread rolls, cut into flakes
ingredients.sourceText: 12 tablespoons peeled bread rolls, cut into flakes

steps: Cut 12 tablespoons of peeled bread rolls into flakes, place in a saucepan, pour 0.25 liter of milk over them and stir over the fire until it forms a thick mixture
Set aside and let cool
Meanwhile, mix 16 tablespoons of softened butter with 16 tablespoons of vanilla sugar
Add 10 egg yolks one after another, stirring
Mix this well with the cooled mixture
Lightly fold in the snow of 8 egg whites
Fill a buttered form dusted with flour with this mixture
Cover and cook 1/3 to 3/4 hours in a water bath or bake in the oven
Turn out onto a serving dish, dust with sugar or pour dissolved jam over it and serve at table

ingredients.name: 2 deca compressed yeast dissolved in 1/8 liter lukewarm cream
ingredients.sourceText: 2 deca compressed yeast dissolved in 1/8 liter lukewarm cream

steps: Mix the beaten butter, vanilla sugar, and salt well together
Add 2 whole eggs and 2 egg yolks one after another, stirring them in
Add the compressed yeast dissolved in lukewarm cream and the flour to the beaten butter, stir well and beat the dough until fine
Let the dough rise covered in a warm place until it has risen somewhat
Place the dough on a flour-dusted board and form pretzels, rings, twists, or other desired shapes
Place these on a baking sheet covered with buttered paper
Let them rise lightly covered for some time in a warm place
Brush with beaten egg and bake slowly in a fairly hot oven

description: Prepared with almonds, egg yolks, and jam.
steps: Rub butter and flour together finely on a board
Add blanched and passed almonds, sugar, lemon zest, spice, nutmeg, and cinnamon

Brush with beaten egg and edge with a finger-thick dough border

Bake for 1/2 to 3/4 hours
Remove and when completely cool, fill the lattice with jam and sprinkle sugar on the edges

title: Bröſelteig⸗Apfelſtrudel (Crumb Dough Apple Strudel)
description: Prepared with egg yolk, apples, and raisins.
steps: Make a crumb dough from 14 decagrams flour, 12.5 decagrams butter, 1 egg yolk, 1 spoonful milk, 1 spoonful sugar, lemon peel, and salt (see doughs)
After resting, roll out thinly and cut into a rectangle
Place on an ungreased baking sheet
Put filling down the middle lengthwise
Fold the dough over from both sides
From the dough scraps, cut narrow strips, brush with egg white, and lay them crosswise on the strudel
Brush the strudel with beaten egg
Bake at high heat until light brown
Cool, cut into equal pieces
Sprinkle with sugar and cool before serving
For the filling: Peel, core, and quarter the apples; stew gently with 8-10 sugar cubes, some lemon peel, a little water, and 3 decagrams raisins; the filling must be dry and only used when cooled

title: Buchteln (Filled Yeast Rolls)
description: A bread preparation made with yeast, butter or beef or lard, and egg yolk.

ingredients.name: jam, powidl (plum paste), quark filling, or poppy seed filling
ingredients.sourceText: jam, powidl (plum paste), quark filling, or poppy seed filling

steps: Warm the flour in a mixing bowl with salt and 2 spoons sugar.
Rub in 8 dkg butter or beef lard in pieces, add 1 egg, 1 egg yolk, the risen yeast starter, and lukewarm milk as needed.
Beat the dough until it detaches from the spoon, cover it, and let it rise near the stove.

When it has doubled in size, use a floured spoon to place small pieces of dough on a floured board, stretch them out with floured fingers, fill them with jam, powidl, quark filling, or poppy seed filling, close the dough over the filling, place them with the filled side down in a well-greased pan close together, brush each one on top and on the sides with melted fat, and fill the pan this way.
If the pan is too large, place a stick wrapped in paper against the last rolls.
Let them rise for another 15 minutes near the stove and bake them at moderate heat until light brown.
Turn them out, sprinkle with sugar while still hot, separate them, and serve cooled.

description: Prepared with rolls, currants, and raisins.
steps: Bake the 28 Deka of trimmed, thinly sliced rolls in the oven.
Lay them two by two on top of each other, brushing between with any desired preserved filling.
Line the bottom of a mold brushed with butter and dusted with flour with these rolls.
Sprinkle these with dried currants, raisins, finely cut almonds, and finely cut citron peel.

Once it has absorbed somewhat, bake for 1 1/2 hours in the oven.

title: Butter Cake (Tourte aa beurre)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, egg whites, and butter.
steps: Beat 28 deca butter until fluffy, mix in 28 deca vanilla sugar
Gradually beat in 8 egg yolks for 1/2 hour
Lightly mix in the snow of 8 egg whites with 28 deca flour
Divide this mass into 2 parts, fill into buttered and floured cake forms and bake at low heat in the oven
Remove the hoops from the forms, place the cakes on a board or sieve, and after complete cooling, spread with dissolved jam

title: Butter Pastry Dough (Pâte Feuilletée)
description: Prepared with wheat flour, butter or salt, and brandy.

ingredients.name: the finest wheat flour
ingredients.sourceText: One pound of the finest wheat flour

ingredients.name: Three quarters pound good unsalted butter, or butter freed of salt by multiple washings
ingredients.sourceText: Three quarters pound good unsalted butter, or butter freed of salt by multiple washings

ingredients.name: One spoon full of good French brandy
ingredients.sourceText: One spoon full of good French brandy

ingredients.name: full of sweet cream
ingredients.sourceText: One tablespoon full of sweet cream

steps: Lay half of the flour on a smooth, clean table, preferably on a marble plate, make a depression in it
Put the eggs, brandy, and cream into the depression
Work this all together into a firm dough so that it can be rolled out
Take half of the butter, lay it on the rolled out dough, fold the dough over the butter
Sprinkle with a portion of the remaining flour, choose a new spot on the table, then turn the dough mass so that the upper side lies on the flour-dusted spot
Roll the entire mass out and together several times, then take the other half of the butter and do the same as with the first, until all the flour is used
Then roll out the dough fairly thin and cut it according to the form you wish to give the pastry
Finally, lay the dough in layers one upon another to the height desired
Between each layer brush a little egg yolk, and brush it on the outside as well so that the pastry obtains a beautiful, golden-brown color

title: Butterteig (Butter Dough)
description: Prepared with butter, vinegar or wine or lemon juice, and flour.

ingredients.name: 2 spoonfuls vinegar or wine or lemon juice
ingredients.sourceText: 2 spoonfuls vinegar or wine or lemon juice

steps: Place the flour on a pastry board. Knead one third of it with the butter and form it into a brick shape, place on ice.

With the remaining flour, salt, 1 egg, 2 spoonfuls vinegar (or wine or lemon juice) and 2 spoonfuls cold water, make a strudel dough, work it very well until tender, and let it rest under a cold pot for 15 minutes.
Roll it out into a rectangle, place the butter brick in the middle, fold the dough from top to bottom and vice versa, also from right to left over it.
Carefully tap with the rolling pin first in the middle, then at top and bottom so the butter distributes.

Lightly roll it out so that a long but not wide strip (approximately 45 cm long, 15 cm wide) is formed, fold it into thirds, turn the dough so the open sides are at top and bottom and roll it out again to a strip.
Fold together once more and roll out. After folding and rolling out a third time, fold the dough a third time, wrap in paper, place on ice or in a cold place.
Let it rest at least 20 minutes. After that, roll out and fold together three more times, place on ice until this has been repeated a third time.
Before using, it must rest for a full hour to become stiff. Then it can be rolled out as thick or thin as desired.

It is best to make the dough in the evening and use it the next day. Leftover pieces are placed together, tapped with the rolling pin and rolled out again. They should not be kneaded together by hand as the dough would become too warm and not work.

The dough is always placed on an ungreased sheet and needs a hot oven. The butter pastries (vol au vent) can be made earlier and reheated, as they are better warm, or they are baked and filled in the last moment. The dough bakes for approximately 8-15 minutes.

sourceSteps: Place the flour on a pastry board. Knead one third of it with the butter and form it into a brick shape, place on ice.

With the remaining flour, salt, 1 egg, 2 spoonfuls vinegar (or wine or lemon juice) and 2 spoonfuls cold water, make a strudel dough, work it very well until tender, and let it rest under a cold pot for 15 minutes.
Roll it out into a rectangle, place the butter brick in the middle, fold the dough from top to bottom and vice versa, also from right to left over it.
Carefully tap with the rolling pin first in the middle, then at top and bottom so the butter distributes.

Lightly roll it out so that a long but not wide strip (approximately 45 cm long, 15 cm wide) is formed, fold it into thirds, turn the dough so the open sides are at top and bottom and roll it out again to a strip.
Fold together once more and roll out. After folding and rolling out a third time, fold the dough a third time, wrap in paper, place on ice or in a cold place.
Let it rest at least 20 minutes. After that, roll out and fold together three more times, place on ice until this has been repeated a third time.
Before using, it must rest for a full hour to become stiff. Then it can be rolled out as thick or thin as desired.

It is best to make the dough in the evening and use it the next day. Leftover pieces are placed together, tapped with the rolling pin and rolled out again. They should not be kneaded together by hand as the dough would become too warm and not work.

The dough is always placed on an ungreased sheet and needs a hot oven. The butter pastries (vol au vent) can be made earlier and reheated, as they are better warm, or they are baked and filled in the last moment. The dough bakes for approximately 8-15 minutes.

title: Butterteig feinster Art (Puff Pastry of the Finest Kind)
description: A pastry dish made with butter, flour, and salt.
steps: Lay butter on the flour and beat them together widely with the butter.
Turn the dough so that the two open sides lie right and left, tap lightly with the rolling pin on the middle of the dough and push the butter through rolling until toward the edge.
Once the dough is rolled out lengthwise into a strip, fold it from right to left again so that it lies in 3 equal parts over one another.
Place it on a tray dusted with flour and let it rest covered at a cold place.
After about 1/4 hour, place the dough again on the flour-dusted board so that the open sides lie right and left, roll it out and proceed as before.
Repeat this three times, after which the dough can be used in various ways, for strudel, pastries, etc.

title: Butterteig zu Stefanies Sufferln und kleinen Bäckereien (Puff Pastry for Stefanies Sufferln and Small Pastries)
description: A pastry dish made with egg yolks, butter, and sugar.
steps: Beat 24 Deca beaten butter gradually with 8 Deca finely crushed sugar, 1 knife-point of finely cut lemon peel and 3 egg yolks until well mixed.
Mix thoroughly with 32 Deca flour.
Smooth the dough on a flour-dusted board and let it rest covered at a cold place.
Once the dough feels firm, roll it out on a flour-dusted board knife-back thick, divide it into 2 equal parts.
Roll one part onto a rolling pin and unroll it onto a buttered baking sheet.
Brush the dough with beaten egg, leaving a finger-width border free on all 4 sides, which brush with whipped egg white.
Roll the second part of the dough onto the rolling pin and place it over the brushed dough so that the edges lie evenly on one another, pressing them together.
Brush the dough with whipped egg and bake in the oven at medium heat until golden.
Remove the baking sheet and once the dough has completely cooled, glaze it with glaze.
Once the glaze is completely dry, cut the dough into finger-width strips.

title: Butterteig, feinster Art (Puff Pastry, Finest Type - Feuilletage)
description: A pastry dish made with egg yolks, juice, and flour.

ingredients.name: 56 drachm very cold and firm butter
ingredients.sourceText: 56 drachm very cold and firm butter

steps: Place flour on a pastry board and cut very cold and firm butter into small pieces into one-third of the flour using a knife
With a pastry roller, lightly strike until the flour has absorbed the butter and the butter appears flaky
Form the butter in an oblong shape, place on a board dusted with flour, cover with a cloth, and set in a cool place or on ice
Make a well in the remaining flour on the board, add {{source-2}}, 4 egg yolks, and the juice of 1/2 lemon
Stir while gradually adding {{source-5}} with the left hand, using the right hand to form a dough
Work the dough as you would strudel dough with both hands until blisters appear
If the dough contains too much moisture and sticks to the board, dust both hands and board with a little flour, but do not work in too much flour or the dough will become too stiff
Once blisters appear, place the dough on a flour-dusted board, dust with flour, and roll out with a pastry roller while the butter is still cold
Place the cold butter on top and fold the dough together with the butter on both sides
Turn the dough so the open sides are on the right and left, lightly tap the middle of the dough with the pastry roller, and push the butter through by rolling until it reaches the edges
Once the dough is rolled out lengthwise into a strip, fold again from right to left so it lies in 3 equal layers on top of each other
Place on a flour-dusted sheet pan and let rest covered in a cool place
After approximately 1/4 hour, place the dough again on a flour-dusted board

title: Butterteigsterne (Butter Dough Stars)
description: Prepared with marmalade, flour, and eggs.
steps: When you have prepared a butter dough from 28 Deka flour and rolled it out to knife-back thickness, cut finger-long and finger-wide strips with slanted ends
Take 6 such strips, of which the two lowest are the longest, the two middle ones somewhat shorter and the two uppermost the shortest, and layer them crosswise to form a star
Before placing one strip on another, brush the middle of each dough strip with beaten egg so that one holds the other
Press the top strip strongly in the middle with the finger, which creates a depression
Place these stars on a sheet dampened with water using a knife, make several incisions in each strip with a knife, brush the stars with beaten egg and bake them at fairly strong heat in the oven
When this is done, remove them from the sheet with a thin knife, fill the depression made with the finger in the middle with desired marmalade, sprinkle with finely ground sugar and serve
They can also be baked in hot lard

title: Buttetertig-Straße (Puff Pastry Strip)
description: A pastry dish made with puff pastry and eggs.
steps: After the puff pastry (No. 1045) has rested for 1/4 hour, roll it out on a flour-dusted board to the thickness of a small finger and, as desired, cut it round, square, or oval, which should always match the shape of the designated dish.
Cut out the center of this pastry sheet so that only a 3-finger wide border remains.
Place the cut-out puff pastry on a board moistened with water and brush the pastry with beaten eggs in such a way that a knife-back-wide border remains.
The remaining scraps of puff pastry are also rolled out, cut or stamped as desired, and laid in any pattern on the puff pastry ring.
Brush these also with beaten eggs, but not the edges.
Place the puff pastry ring in the oven and bake it initially at strong heat, later at moderate heat.
So that the puff pastry does not become too dark, it can be covered with paper after it turns yellow.

The puff pastry is then removed from the oven, placed in the designated dish, and served with a ragout or served two rings stacked on top of each other, make a knife-back-thick cover from the same dough, bake it at the same time next to the 2 rings, arrange the ragout or fricassee in the center, place the baked cover on top, and serve a sauce in a sauce boat.

title: Béchamel
description: Prepared with veal, ham, and turnips.
steps: Cut {{source-0}} and {{source-1}} into small pieces.
Place in a casserole with some yellow turnips, small onions, 2 cloves, bay leaves, thyme, and {{source-7}}.
Let everything draw slowly on low coals, stirring often to prevent the meat from sticking to the bottom or darkening.
Stir {{source-8}} into the casserole.
Once well mixed, pour in 0.5 measure of cream.
Stir with a cooking spoon until the sauce begins to boil.
Simmer gently for 1.5 hours until it reduces properly.
If it becomes too thick, add some milk.
Do not salt heavily as ham is already present.
The sauce should bind and look like porridge.
If still too thick when serving, add some cream or good milk, strain through cheesecloth, and use as needed.

sourceSteps: Cut 1 pound veal and 1.5 pounds ham into small pieces.
Place in a casserole with some yellow turnips, small onions, 2 cloves, bay leaves, thyme, and 0.5 pound butter.
Let everything draw slowly on low coals, stirring often to prevent the meat from sticking to the bottom or darkening.
Stir 5 tablespoons flour into the casserole.
Once well mixed, pour in 0.5 measure of cream.
Stir with a cooking spoon until the sauce begins to boil.
Simmer gently for 1.5 hours until it reduces properly.
If it becomes too thick, add some milk.
Do not salt heavily as ham is already present.
The sauce should bind and look like porridge.
If still too thick when serving, add some cream or good milk, strain through cheesecloth, and use as needed.

title: Béchamel Soufflé (Soufflé à la Béchamel)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, egg whites, and butter.

ingredients.name: finely ground almonds or hazelnuts (optional)
ingredients.sourceText: 8 tablespoons finely ground almonds or hazelnuts (optional)

steps: Place butter, sugar, and flour in a saucepan and finely mash with a spoon
Pour in 1.5 liters of hot milk and stir quickly over the fire until the dough separates from the pan
Transfer to a deep bowl and let cool completely
Stir in 9 egg yolks one after another
Lightly fold in the snow of 9 egg whites, and if desired, 8 tablespoons of finely ground almonds or hazelnuts
Fill a buttered form dusted with flour with this mixture
Cover and cook 3/4 to 1 hour in a water bath or bake slowly in the oven at low heat
If desired, add 5 tablespoons of strong black coffee with the milk

title: Büftek mit Erdäpfelpürce (Beef Steaks with Potato Purée)
description: Prepared with beef, potatoes, and meat.

ingredients.name: a strong handful of fresh parsley
ingredients.sourceText: a strong handful of fresh parsley

ingredients.name: half a teaspoon of ground pepper

steps: Make a purée or pressed dish of potatoes as follows: cook the potatoes, peel them, and when they have cooled, grate them on a grater
In a casserole, warm a piece of butter, add one cooking spoon of flour, which should brown slightly but not become dark
Add the grated potatoes and pour good meat broth over it in proportion, stir it until it looks like a cook's work, salt it and let it cook well

From a lung roast, which must first be washed and beaten well, cut thin round slices, salt them, mix together 3 onions of medium size, a strong handful of finely chopped fresh parsley, and half a teaspoon of ground pepper

Put some spoonfuls of fat in a flat pan, place the meat slices with the cut ingredients in it, and let it stew until the slices are cooked through; the onion and parsley inside should only become light yellow

When serving, the potato purée, which is mixed with the strained fat from the slices, comes first on the dish, then the slices thickly coated with the stewed onions and parsley are laid in order on top, and brought to table

title: Calf's Meat Prepared with the Appearance and Taste of Marinated Tuna (Art und Weise, das Kalbfleisch mit dem Aussehen und dem Geschmack eines marinierten Thunfisches zuzubereiten)
description: Prepared with onions, bay leaf, and garlic.

ingredients.name: One quarter pound very dry finely grated salt
ingredients.sourceText: One quarter pound very dry finely grated salt

steps: Take a white fresh calf's leg and cut out the inner part (the fricandeaux) as large as possible.
Let it stand for a couple of days in a cool place to tenderize; in summer no longer than one day.
Remove the skin and sinews and divide the piece into four parts.
Have ready a quarter pound of very dry finely grated salt and rub the calf pieces thoroughly with it as in the preparation of salted beef.
Place it in a stone pot, add sliced onions, whole parsley, thyme, a bay leaf, ginger, garlic, cranberries, pepper, and three washed finely pounded anchovies.
Mix everything well together and bind with a cloth.
After four days, turn it over and let it stand bound for another four days.
Then pour off half the liquid and put the other half with the calf pieces and other ingredients into a casserole.
Add a bottle of good white wine and let it cook slowly over gentle heat.
When it is tender, set it aside, place it in the same terrine or pot it was in before, and put it in a cool place to marinate well.
The next day, place the meat on a hair sieve to drain, then into a clean terrine or glass, and pour in enough fine oil to cover it completely.
Finally bind it well with a bladder.

title: Caramel Soufflé (Soufflé au caramel)
description: A confection made with cream, egg yolks, and egg whites.
steps: Dip 12 drams sugar in water, place in a casserole, and heat without stirring until the sugar is brown.
Add 6 tablespoons cold water and simmer until the sugar is completely dissolved and liquid.
Set aside and let cool.
Pour {{source-3}} over 12 drams flour and stir.
Add 5 egg yolks, 3 whole eggs, 16 drams butter, and the cooled, dissolved caramel sugar.
Stir over heat until the mixture has thickened considerably.
Set aside and let cool.
Beat 16 drams sugar with 8 egg yolks for 1/4 hour.
Slowly mix this into the thickened, cold mixture.
Lightly fold in the snow from 8 egg whites.
Fill a buttered, flour-dusted melon mold.
Cover and steam or bake for 3/4 hour in a water bath.

The cream will be ready in ten minutes and is served cold

title: Carpe à la bohemienne (Bohemian Carp with Black Sauce)
description: A sauce made with carp, butter or lard, and onion.

ingredients.name: 8 decagrams dark and 8 decagrams light raisins
ingredients.sourceText: 8 decagrams dark and 8 decagrams light raisins

steps: In a pot place 12 decagrams butter or lard, 1 piece onion, some root vegetables, all finely sliced, the chopped carp head, 10 pieces blanched raisins, 10 pieces raw dried pitted prunes, 16 decagrams finely sliced black bread, 8 decagrams dark and 8 decagrams light raisins, 5 sprigs thyme, 5 sprigs fresh parsley, 2 bay leaves, 5 grains each of spice, 1 spice nail, 1 very small piece of cinnamon and 4 decagrams sugar
Let this braise covered for 15 minutes, then pour it with {{source-15}}, {{source-16}} and {{source-17}} and let it braise covered
If the carp blood is available, stir it with vinegar and add it to the sauce and stir
If the sauce is too thick, add some fish broth and pass it
As soon as this is done, add blanched raisins, currants, some raisins and peeled finely cut almonds and let it come to a boil once more
This sauce must be sweet-sour and bitter and have a pleasant spicy taste
If it is too thin, add some butter sauce; if it is not dark enough, stir in a few spoonfuls of caramel sugar
The fish of approximately 2 kilos is meanwhile cut and prepared in the same way as indicated for the 'Sour Boiled Carp with Root Vegetables'
Arrange it with some sauce on the dish and serve desired dumplings or semolina strudel with it
The remaining sauce is served in a sauce boat
Any kind of fish can be prepared in this way

title: Carpe à la marinière (Sour Boiled Carp with Root Vegetables and Dill)
description: Prepared with vegetables, carp, and vinegar.
steps: Cook a broth of {{source-0}} and {{source-1}} with 1 finely diced onion and finely diced root vegetables, 1 bay leaf, some thyme, pepper and necessary salt
Let this cook for 1/4 hour
While this is cooking, scale the fish, open it, clean it, split it lengthwise and cut it into pieces 2 fingers wide, which are sprinkled with salt
Split the head lengthwise in 2 parts and add it to the softened root vegetables
After 1/4 hour add the fish pieces and let them come to a boil once, then set them aside covered in the pot
Shortly before serving, place the fish on the dish, which can be garnished with the cooked root vegetables and grated dill, and add some of the broth
Serve mustard or mustard sauce with it

title: Champagne Auflauf (Champagne Soufflé)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, wine, and egg whites.

ingredients.name: finely crushed sugar for the pan
ingredients.sourceText: finely crushed sugar for the pan

steps: In a glazed pot, add 5 egg yolks, which are whisked on the hot plate with {{source-1}} mixed with 8 teaspoons of sugar until it begins to thicken and rises in height, then set aside and whisk until completely cooled
To this, beat 4 teaspoons of beaten butter with 6 egg yolks and finally lightly fold in the snow from 6 egg whites

A desired butter-greased, finely crushed sugar-dusted form is lined with baked biscuit, half of the chaudeau is poured in, which is again covered with biscuit and the second half of the chaudeau is poured over

Let it cook covered for 1/2 hour in a water bath, after which time the soufflé is turned out onto a plate and baked in the oven for a few minutes; dust it with finely crushed sugar and serve immediately
This soufflé must be made very carefully

Place on a platter, set one mushroom on each crouton, and garnish with parsley.

description: Prepared with veal, bacon, and meat.

ingredients.name: 6 decagrams crusts removed, softened in milk, well pressed rolls
ingredients.sourceText: 6 decagrams crusts removed, softened in milk, well pressed rolls

steps: Chop the veal meat and bacon very finely with a sharp knife
Place in a mortar and pound with 3 whole eggs, 6 decagrams of crusts removed, softened in milk and well pressed rolls, and 4 tablespoons of meat cream until fine
Pass through a sieve into a deep bowl
Add 4 cleaned, washed, finely diced anchovies, 12 crayfish tails or 6 shelled oysters and 8 decagrams of finely sliced truffles
Salt and season to taste and mix well together
Truss the capon as for chickens, salt it, fill it with the above forcemeat, truss it, bind it with bacon and roast it on a spit or in the oven
When finished roasting, cut it into pieces of choice, reassemble it on a platter and garnish it with watercress and with lemon and orange wedges
Serve the capon with any salad desired and the resulting juices

title: Chapon à la Sauce de Gibier (Capon with Game Sauce)
description: A sauce made with capon, game, and capers.
steps: A cleaned, trimmed, beaten, trussed capon is larded, placed in a suitable vessel, covered with game marinade and, if time permits, left to soak for 1 day in the marinade
8 hours is also sufficient
After this time, remove the capon and roast it by frequent basting with butter for 1 to 1 and 1/2 hours on a spit
Or place the capon in a pan containing butter and roast it under frequent basting with the resulting juices in the oven
If desired, a butter sauce may be made with some marinade and simmered well
After this, add some cream, and once this has thinned, add 1 tablespoon of capers and cleaned, finely diced anchovies
Let the sauce simmer once and serve it in a sauceboat with the capon
The capon, which has been cut into pieces of choice and reassembled on a platter, is garnished with simulated snipe liver, lemon wedges and watercress

title: Chartreuse de Pommes (Apple Chartreuse)
description: Prepared with apple, apples, and lemon juice.

ingredients.name: Various preserved fruits: apricots, currants, etc.
ingredients.sourceText: Various preserved fruits: apricots, currants, etc.

steps: Peel about 12 beautiful apples, give them form with a pastry cutter, and lay them immediately in water with lemon juice so they remain white.
Clarify three quarters pound sugar and mix with lemon juice.
Lay the cut-out apples, which must always be in an oblong round form, in the clarified sugar, and bring them to a boil a couple of times.
Remove them and lay them on a hair sieve.
Cook the apple scraps remaining from the cutting into a marmalade and let them cool.
Butter a casserole, layer the oblong-cut apples symmetrically in a circle around the bottom.
Spread apple marmalade thickly on top, fill the middle of the casserole with apricot marmalade, then continue with apple marmalade until the casserole is full.
Place it for a moment in boiling water and turn it out onto a platter.
Cook a good syrup from the remaining juice and pour it over.
Garnish these apples with various preserved fruits, apricots, currants, etc.

title: Chateaubriands (Double Beefsteak)
description: Prepared with tenderloin, fat, and truffle.

ingredients.name: 1 piece raw or cooked truffle, cut into leaves
ingredients.sourceText: 1 piece raw or cooked truffle, cut into leaves

steps: From a skinned tenderloin, cut 4 finger-thick slices.
Flatten these with the flat of a knife, press lightly together so that they have the proper height and rounding.

description: Prepared with cherries, sugar, and water.
steps: Cut the stems of the cherries halfway off.

Allow to cool and serve in a compote dish.

title: Chestnut Croquettes (Kastanien-Croquettes)
description: Prepared with chestnuts, cream, and egg yolks.
steps: Shell 50 roasted chestnuts, pound and pass 25 of them through a sieve
Add {{source-2}}, {{source-3}}, 1 pinch salt, and some cream to the passed chestnuts
Stir over heat until it becomes a dough
Set aside and after it has cooled somewhat, gradually stir in 6 egg yolks
After completely cooling, place the mass on a flour-dusted board and divide into portions
Arrange them evenly separated, place a halved chestnut in the middle of each, and cover evenly with the dough
Dip in beaten egg, roll in breadcrumbs, and fry in very hot lard
Remove with a slotted spoon when light golden, place briefly on blotting paper, and arrange in a bowl covered with a napkin

title: Chicken Purée Soup (Purée de volaille)
description: Prepared with mushrooms, chicken, and peas.
steps: Place butter, a small bouquet of green parsley and 3 pieces of thinly sliced mushrooms in a casserole
Add 1 whole chicken and roast it
After roasting, add 1/2 liter of white soup and let it braise gently
Remove the chicken, skin it, and remove the bones
Pound the bones into the casserole where the chicken was braised
Add 2 liters of soup and boil well
To the removed chicken meat, add 8 ounces of soft peas and pound this together very finely in a mortar
Place the pounded mixture in a casserole, pour the chicken soup over it, stir in the necessary salt and let it boil well
Pass it through with 4 hard egg yolks, place the pot in hot water so the soup does not boil, but stir it frequently with a serving spoon
The soup is usually served with braised rice or fried bread
You can also add chicken breast cut into pieces and peas boiled in salt water

description: Prepared with cauliflower, mushrooms, and bread.
steps: Clean and wash the young chicken, and place it in a pot with cold salted water and optional soup greens, except for the liver.
Cook for 1-1½ hours depending on the age of the chicken.
Add the liver later in the cooking process.
Remove the chicken and cut it into pieces.
Make a light roux with 8 dkg butter and parsley, and pour it into the strained chicken broth.
Add the chicken pieces, cauliflower, and mushrooms (which have been cleaned, washed, and separately cooked in salted water for 20 minutes).
Cook everything together well.
Serve the soup with bread slices or bread dumplings.

steps: Cut each of 2 cleaned chickens into 4 pieces with the shoulder joint cut through the back
Place in a casserole containing fat, thinly sliced onion, bay leaf, and thyme
Cover and braise
When the liquid that forms has evaporated, pour in ¼ liter wine

Cover and braise briefly

Remove chickens, arrange in a serving dish, garnish with potatoes, and pour sauce over
Optionally stir in 2 tablespoons capers or 1½ teaspoons finely chopped green parsley or chervil and bring to a boil once
Instead of potatoes, diced turnips or macaroni cooked in salted water can be used to garnish

If desired, add 8 tea cups sugar at the beginning and serve with powdered sugar and whipped cream

description: Prepared with chocolate, egg whites, and almonds or pistachios.

ingredients.name: fine pounded and sifted almonds, pistachios or pignoli

steps: Prepare a dough from 24 deca chocolate and 12 deca sugar as directed for Chocolates-Kugeln
Spread the warm dough on a sugar-sprinkled paper and roll out knife-back thickness with a sugar-dusted rolling pin
Have previously prepared stiffly whipped whites of 2 eggs mixed with 3 deca sugar and {{source-4}}
Spread this mixture knife-back thickness on the rolled chocolate dough
Fold the dough once so the edges lie evenly together on all sides
Spread the folded dough again knife-back thickness with the egg white mixture
Cover this by folding the dough once more as indicated
Cut the dough into thumb-width strips, then cut these into finger-width squares
Dry in air

If this happens, return the chocolate mass to the double boiler and warm through with a few drops of water
Alternatively, hot marmalade may be used instead of the egg white mixture
The chocolate dough may also be filled into paper cases half full, topped with a little marmalade, then filled to the top with warm chocolate mass and dried in air

title: Chokolade (Hot Chocolate)
description: Prepared with chocolate and water or milk.
steps: Allow 2 loth chocolate per chocolate cup, cut or grated on a grater
Place in a pot and let come to a boil
Remove from the fire and let stand a little
Place cups in hot water
Stir the chocolate with a stirrer or whisk into foam
Use a small foam spoon to fill the cups with foam until they are completely heaped full
Optionally, lightly bake the foam with a glowing shovel held half an inch above the cups to prevent it from settling too quickly
Serve mostly with rusks or finely toasted roll
Milk can be used instead of water with the same procedure
If making chocolate in Rhenish wine or Champagne, ensure the Champagne does not burn, do not spare the sugar, and allow for 1 egg yolk per cup to whip the chocolate with

title: Choux rouges (Red Cabbage)
description: Prepared with cabbage, vinegar, and fat.

ingredients.name: 1 red cabbage, cored and ribs removed
ingredients.sourceText: 1 red cabbage, cored and ribs removed

steps: After coring and removing the ribs from the cabbage, roll it together and cut finely into noodle-like strips.
Pour some vinegar over it, mix well with salt and let stand 1/2 hour.
In 12 decagrams fat, roast 1 finely cut head of onion.
Add the cabbage to the onion with 6 decagrams sugar and {{source-6}}.
Cover and braise 15 minutes, then stir well.
Add {{source-7}} and {{source-8}} and continue braising covered until the cabbage is completely soft.
Add approximately 1/2 liter butter sauce, stir well and let boil thoroughly.
If the cabbage is not sour enough, add the necessary vinegar and salt and let boil again.
Serve with smoked meat and sausages.

title: Choux rouges braisés (Braised Red Cabbage)
description: Prepared with cabbage, fat, and onion.
steps: In 12 decagrams hot fat, let 6 decagrams crushed sugar brown.
Let 1 finely cut head of onion roast lightly, then add the cabbage as described above and let braise together somewhat.
Add enough broth and vinegar so that it covers the cabbage.
When the liquid has completely evaporated and the cabbage is rather soft, dust with {{source-7}}, stir well and let evaporate somewhat more.
Pour with approximately 1/2 liter broth, stir well and let boil.
Add the necessary salt and, if not sour enough, some vinegar.
The cabbage should be pleasantly sweet-sour.
You can also add butter sauce instead of the flour dust. The cabbage must be agreeably sweet-sour.

title: Cimmelhnus Auflauf (Cinnamon Soufflé)
description: Prepared with cinnamon, egg yolks, and egg whites.
steps: In 1/2 liter of boiling milk, whisk in 20 teaspoons of ground cinnamon with constant stirring and let it cook briefly
Add 12 teaspoons of butter, stir well and set aside
Meanwhile, beat 6 egg yolks and 12 teaspoons of vanilla sugar for 1/2 hour, add the cooled mixture, stir well together

Fill half of this mass into a butter-greased, flour-dusted pan, place in the oven, let it set slightly, then cover with desired cooked filling, add the second half of the mass and bake covered for 3/4 hour in a water bath or in the oven

description: Prepared with stock, vinegar, and juice.

ingredients.name: 2 calf thymus glands or 1 half calf thymus gland
ingredients.sourceText: 2 calf thymus glands or 1 half calf thymus gland

steps: Boil the calf thymus glands in salt water until soft.
Remove from water and cut into almond-like pieces once cooled.
In a pot, toast the flour in butter, add finely chopped parsley and onion if desired, and brown.
Deglaze with {{source-6}} and {{source-7}}.
Stir well together, salt and pepper to taste.
Add 1/4 liter sour cream if desired and 1 pinch of lemon peel.
Add the juice of 1/2 lemon with the prepared veal thymus gland pieces.
Let cook together well.
The sauce should be pleasantly sour and not too thick.
Optionally, a small head of cauliflower can be braised with it, but removed before serving.
The veal thymus gland can also be served with fried eggs if desired.

title: Cock's Combs (Crêtes de Coq)
description: Prepared with chicken, lemon juice, and water.
steps: Take chicken combs that have been trimmed slightly at the tips and place them in lukewarm water so they become white
Once this is achieved, place them again in lukewarm water, remove them and lay them on a cloth
Salt them well and rub with the cloth until the fine skin comes off
Place them in cold water and keep them at a warm place until the water becomes lukewarm
Repeat this until the combs are completely white
Place 1 3/4 liters of water, 4 ounces of butter and the juice of 1 lemon in a casserole, add the chicken combs and bring to a boil only once
Use them for various ragouts

title: Concombres farcis (Stuffed Cucumbers)
description: Prepared with cucumbers, veal or forcemeat or fish, and bacon.
steps: Peel the cucumbers, cut them in half lengthwise, hollow them out and fill firmly with veal forcemeat or fish forcemeat.
Wrap them in thin bacon leaves.
Place in a shallow casserole so that the filled end lies against the side of the casserole.
Add enough boiling salt water to cover the cucumbers.
Braise covered until soft.
Carefully remove them, cut into desired pieces and use for dressing beef or other meat dishes.

title: Consommé (Semolina Consommé)
description: A soup made with semolina, egg yolks, and egg whites.
steps: Bring 2 dl milk to a boil with 4 dkg butter and salt.
Stir in 6 dkg semolina spoonful by spoonful to make a thick mixture and let cool.
Fold in 2 egg yolks and 2 beaten egg whites.
Fill the mixture into a consommé mold.
Let it set in a steamer for 30-45 minutes.
Loosen, turn out, cut into pieces, and serve warm.
